mapper.select: SELECT cr.*, f.file_url, u.name FROM class_review cr LEFT JOIN user u ON cr.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN file f ON u.file_no = f.file_no WHERE cr.class_id = #{classId}

SELECT p.*, u.name AS username, COUNT(c.comment_id) AS commentCount FROM community_post p LEFT JOIN community_comment c ON p.post_id = c.post_id LEFT JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.class_id = #{classId} GROUP BY p.post_id ORDER BY p.post_id DESC;
SELECT cp.*, u.name AS username FROM community_post cp INNER JOIN user u ON cp.user_id = u.user_id WHERE cp.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: insert into class_review (user_id, class_id, rating, content, created_at) values(#{review.userId},#{review.classId},#{review.rating},#{review.content},now())
mapper.select: select * from class_section where class_id = #{classId} and class_permit = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into community_post (class_id, user_id, title, content, created_at, category) values (#{classId}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, now(), 'C')
insert into community_comment (post_id, user_id, content, created_at) values (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, now())
